name: arc left open
speaker: Cole
line: Cole at Drydock, south yard. arc left open. 7 steps. The drum stays for the start.

speaker: Ada
line: Ada: Hold the drum at Drydock. Nobody past the south yard. We start in 8 steps. Arc on the left lane, open.

name: Drydock south yard
